alloy.preparation: 304L commercial sheet and/or rod, used without any further heat treatment. Circular-flat or cylindrical electrode, screwed into sample holder with 1 cm² exposed. Individual manufacturing schedule and pitting-electrode surface finish are not separately restated. Wheel-ground/180-grit/as-received crevice coupons and the 600-grit/nitric-prepassivated accelerated-CCS electrodes are separately described protocols.

test_solution.preparation: Analytical-grade NaCl dissolved in distilled water; aqueous chloride solutions adjusted to pH 7.8 using NaOH. Component amounts of NaCl and NaOH are not reported separately from chloride-ion concentration. Gas conditioning is not independently restated for this pitting scan.

test_method.procedure_description: Potentiodynamic pitting measurement at 50 °C; 1 cm² electrode. Corrosion-cell setup described in this PDF uses SCE reference with KCl salt bridge and graphite counters. General potentiodynamic/polarization-resistance setup details are referred to a prior publication and are not retrieved. This PDF does not independently specify a sweep rate or hold schedule for the registered Table 5/Figures 2, 5 and 6 Ep measurements. The separately described 10 mV/s scan from −600 to +100 mV measures active-peak height for acidified simulated-crevice CCS determination and is not assigned as the pitting scan rate.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Epit is the potential at which a consistent increase in current density occurs, indicating initiation of non-passivating pits. Ecorr, corrosion rate, active-peak height and CCS pH are different quantities; no fixed numerical current threshold is supplied for this Epit criterion.

experiments.result_note: Epit assessed at a consistent current increase indicating non-passivating pits. SCE reference stated in experimental setup. Table 1 bulk percent notation, explicitly stated Fe balance and printed composition ranges are retained without normalizing units or making balance calculations. Dashes/unquantified elements remain null. Separate accelerated-CCS N2 purge, acid additions, 30 min air exposure and 17% HNO3 prepassivation are not unconditionally imposed on these pitting measurements. Source table/figure disagreements remain qualifications; raw anchored potentials are unchanged.
